notes.title: Early Access Launches - October 1
notes.notes: [p align="start"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618310/7691577546053397a88c0d9731e1a55b20c64c86.gif"][/img][/p][p align="start"]  [/p][h2]It’s official - [b]Flick Solitaire launches in Early Access on October 1.[/b] With a fresh new Store Page waiting for you![/h2][p align="start"]‎   [/p][p align="start"]First, a huge thank you to everyone who has added us to your wishlist. Your support means the world as we’ve been building this next-gen solitaire experience for the last five years.[/p][p align="start"]Solitaire is the ultimate classic, a timeless gem that has been loved for generations. We wanted to share that magic with a NEW generation of players, reimagined with smooth gameplay, stunning decks by diverse indie artists, and chill vibes that let you sink in, whether you're learning or a seasoned pro![/p][p]‎   [/p][h3][b]Why Flick Solitaire?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Classic games, fresh energy[/b]: Play Klondike, Spider, Pyramid and more. FLICK cards![/p][/*][*][p][b]Decks with personality[/b]: 70+ indie artists including Cyanide & Happiness, Rex Crowle (Knights & Bikes, Tear Away, Little Big Planet), Tom Fry (Sonic Mania), and soooo many more. Open packs, unlock styles, and build your collection.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618310/4f680bdbcdd0324402e5eee0fe1815321fda5537.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Looks and feels super satisfying[/b]: Gorgeous animations, smooth UI, cross-platform login.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chill your way[/b]: No timers, no pressure. Just cards, art, and pure solo bliss.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Flick Solitaire is your solo escape - play cards, collect art, and discover new art & artists.[/b][/p][p]‎   [/p][h3][b]Join the community[/b][/h3][list][*][p]📺 [url="https://youtu.be/5PFrXHu-LaQ"]Watch the trailer[/url][/p][/*][*][p]💬 Join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/uHx6rSQC8D"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p]📸 Follow us on [url="https://www.instagram.com/flicksolitaire/"]Instagram[/url][/p][/*][*][p]⭐ Wishlist & Follow Flick Solitaire [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690460/FLICK_SOLITAIRE/"]right here[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]‎   [/p][p align="start"][i]Keep calm, and FLICK on.[/i][/p][p align="start"]— Team Flick[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 7,000 Wishlists! 🎉 Thank You! 🎉
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618310/4f50d63c13f91995ccdb8c92c75e40c81cf1c9c7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Hey Flick Friends![/h2][p]‎ [/p][p]We’ve just hit [b]7,000 WISHLISTS[/b] here on Steam 🎉🎉🎉 A huge milestone for our small team. Whether you found us last week or have been playing Flick on mobile for years, [b]thank you[/b] for being part of this journey.[/p][p]A big part of Flick’s mission has always been to bring the magic of solitaire to a [i]new[/i] generation, with art you can collect, vibes you can feel, and a game you’ll come back to for years to come. Solitaire is timeless, and we want Flick to be your space to unwind.[/p][p]‎ [/p][hr][/hr][p]‎ [/p][h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2][p]‎ [/p][p]🃏 On [b]Day 1[/b], you’ll be able to collect and play with a [b]gorgeous line-up of decks[/b] designed by indie artists from around the world. They're bold, expressive, and fully yours to explore.[/p][p]🎨 We’ll also be sharing [b]behind-the-scenes stories[/b] from the dev team, artist reveals, and a closer look at how we’re reimagining classic solitaire for modern players, with the care and polish it deserves.[/p][p]💬 And yes: Our growing [b]Discord community[/b] is a nice space to chat cards, art, vibes, and all things Flick - if that’s your thing, we’d love to see you there.[/p][p][b]Join us here: https://discord.com/invite/uHx6rSQC8D[/b][/p][p]‎ [/p][hr][/hr][p]‎ [/p][p]Flick’s already live on mobile, if you’re curious, but from day one, our plan has always been to bring Flick to more players and build something even better for new platforms. The Steam edition is a [b]FULL rebuild[/b], new & improved in every way: crafted for PC & Mac with even higher-fidelity graphics to showcase the art in all its glory, a brand-new collection system, and a bunch more surprises we can’t wait to share.[/p][p] ‎ [/p][hr][/hr][p] ‎ [/p][h3]Thanks again for wishlisting and showing so much support![/h3][p]— Team Flick[/p]
